personal.name: Ersel Metz Magbanua
personal.bio: Ersel Metz Magbanua is a software engineer in Rizal, Philippines, building web applications, backend systems, and desktop tools with PHP, Python, C#, and JavaScript.

aboutMe.paragraph1: I'm a Software Engineer who enjoys turning complex ideas into clear, useful software. I work across web applications, backend systems, and desktop tools.
aboutMe.paragraph2: My projects span PHP and Laravel, Python, C# and .NET, JavaScript, and relational databases. I use AI tools to support research, debugging, and iteration while I guide the architecture and verify the code I ship.
aboutMe.paragraph3: I enjoy exploring new technologies, solving practical problems, and collaborating on products that make a meaningful difference.
